purpose: Verified, officially published office-level contact addresses for the recipient-confirmation panel on the result page. This is a contact directory, not a policy source: it tells the student WHERE to send, never WHAT the rules say.
institution: The Education University of Hong Kong (EdUHK)
principle: MailStone does not guess personal email addresses. Only addresses printed on an official EdUHK page or on a document already registered in sources.json may appear here. Every address carries its source_ids, source_url and retrieved_date. Named individuals and course lecturers are never given an invented address: where an office address is not published in the corpus, email is null and a lookup_url plus lookup_note tell the student where to find it themselves. The student must actively confirm each address before it appears in the To: line.
confirmation_contract: A listed address is a lead, not a verified destination. MailStone cannot check whether a given staff member still holds a role on the day the email is sent. Each contact row therefore has a checkbox: ticking it records the student's own confirmation and only then adds the address to the To: line. Nothing is sent automatically.

EDUHK-SEN-SUPPORT.role: SEN Support Services, Student Affairs Office
EDUHK-SEN-SUPPORT.room: Room 01S, 1/F, Cho Kwai Chee Foundation Building
EDUHK-SEN-SUPPORT.notes: Published on the SAO SEN Support Services leaflet and repeated in the SAO reply email signature on 2026-11-09. Corroborated by the HKSAR Education Bureau post-secondary SEN contact directory. This is the only office address in the corpus tied to a specific support route.

EDUHK-GENERAL-ENQUIRY.notes: University-wide general enquiry address. Used as a fallback when the specific office or person for a route has no published address in the corpus: a general enquiry office can direct the student to the right unit without MailStone inventing one.

EDUHK-SAO-GENERAL.notes: General Student Affairs Office address. Shown alongside general enquiries for the no-rule and out-of-scope states, where the correct office has not been identified by a clause.

EDUHK-COUNSELLING.notes: Listed as 'Counselling Services' on the University Contact Us page. Retained in the registry for future support routing; not currently bound to a request type.

EDUHK-CAREER.notes: Listed as 'Career Services' on the University Contact Us page. Retained for future support routing; not currently bound to a request type.

EDUHK-LIBRARY.notes: Retained for future support routing; not currently bound to a request type.

EDUHK-COURSE-LECTURER.role: Course lecturer (the person teaching the course)
EDUHK-COURSE-LECTURER.lookup_note: MailStone does not guess personal email addresses. Find your lecturer's address on the course outline, the programme staff page, or the University staff directory (https://www.eduhk.hk/en/directory). If you cannot find it, use the general enquiry address below to ask which unit to contact.
EDUHK-COURSE-LECTURER.notes: The route role comes from GAR 9.6.1 / 9.2.1, which name the course lecturer. Those clauses do not publish an address, so no address may be asserted here.

EDUHK-FACULTY-DEAN.role: Faculty Dean / Academy Executive Co-Director (formal review only)
EDUHK-FACULTY-DEAN.lookup_note: MailStone does not guess personal email addresses. GAR 9.2.3 requires a written request to the Faculty Dean within 14 working days; find the correct submission address on your programme handbook, the Faculty office page, or the University staff directory (https://www.eduhk.hk/en/directory). The general enquiry address below can direct you.
EDUHK-FACULTY-DEAN.notes: Named in GAR 9.2.3 and Procedures 4.5, neither of which publishes an address.

EDUHK-PROGRAMME-LEADER.lookup_note: MailStone does not guess personal email addresses. GAR 13.1 requires a leave application form approved by the Programme Leader; find the programme office address on your programme handbook or the University staff directory (https://www.eduhk.hk/en/directory). The general enquiry address below can direct you.
EDUHK-PROGRAMME-LEADER.notes: Named in GAR 13.1, which does not publish an address.

EDUHK-SAPPC-SECRETARY.lookup_note: MailStone does not guess personal email addresses. Procedures 4.5 sets out the SAppC appeal but does not publish a submission address here; check the current Student Handbook, the Registry, or the University staff directory (https://www.eduhk.hk/en/directory). The general enquiry address below can direct you.
EDUHK-SAPPC-SECRETARY.notes: Named in Procedures 4.5, which does not publish an address.
